svg.title: How blood glucose is regulated and how long-term high glucose affects organs
svg.desc: The pancreas releases insulin as blood glucose rises. Insulin slows glucose release from the liver and helps muscle and fat take up glucose. Sustained high glucose can damage retinal vessels, blood vessels, kidney filters and peripheral nerves. Loss of sensation and poor circulation put feet at risk.
svg.metadata: Adapted from Mikael Häggström, Male template with organs and Female template with organs (Wikimedia Commons, CC0 1.0). Diabetes data sources and denominators are identified in the report.
